scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting:web
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && firebase deploy --only hosting:admin
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:web && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w admin
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:all && npm run build:functions && npm run lint:functions && npm run test:functions
